card.title: IPad 10 Makes Loud Screeching Noise From Lower Speaker

source.title: IPad 10 Makes Loud Screeching Noise From Lower Speaker

claims.statement: An iPad 10 that screeches through any speaker (speaker fine in another unit) has a failing audio IC beneath the main shield, right-hand side, beside the battery connector.

procedure: Replace the audio IC beside the battery connector.
card.caveats: IC designator only shown in image. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
